claim: Legacy account key representation: 32 seed bytes become 24 little-endian 11-bit indices with eight zero padding bits; word 25 is the first little-endian 11 bits of SHA-512/256(seed). The 24th data index is 0..7, not any of 2048. No BIP39 checksum, PBKDF2 seed or universal-HD mapping is implied. from_private_key exports the first 32 bytes separately from generation. See docs/research/batches/slip39-algorand-cardano.md. Retrieved byte SHA-256 6d9387e3ee7213c14a1dec9f53a22f2880ee80b00df8457430f5ecae21f2c74e.
